//: Phase-6.0-W4 (Doc 32 §W4 deliverable (2)) — the VS Code extension's
OWN coverage ratchet (GT-11: c8 is net-new; the xvfb-run
@vscode/test-electron host already shipped — we add the extension's
coverage to it, not a new harness).
WHAT IS MEASURED: editors/vscode/src/** behavioural coverage. The
Extension-Host suite imports the SUT modules from the tsc `out/`
build (e.g. ../../tree/symbolTree, ../../commands/verifyResult,
../../diagram); tsc emits sourceMap:true, so c8's source-map support
attributes out/**.js V8 coverage back to src/**.ts. We instrument
`out/**` (the executed JS) and remap; `src/**` is the reported,
gated unit. The Extension Host writes V8 profiles because
runTest.ts forwards NODE_V8_COVERAGE into it via extensionTestsEnv
(test-electron spawns a separate Electron process; NODE_V8_COVERAGE
is per-process — without the forward c8 would see an empty profile
and the gate would be vacuously green).
THE RATCHET (Doc 32 §W4 (3)): per-area floor = floor(measured-2%),
monotonic non-decreasing, climbed-to target 85/75. The floors below
were MEASURED 2026-05-18 against the EXISTING 41-test behavioural
Extension-Host suite — NO assertion-free coverage-gaming test was
added (Doc 32 §W4 §5.4, the cardinal sin). NON-VACUITY: a deliberate
threshold-bump makes `npm run coverage:gate` exit non-zero (the
RED-proof transcript is in the W4 completion report); restore.
EXCLUSIONS (enumerated, justified — NOT a blanket lower number):
- src/test/**           the test harness itself is not SUT.
- src/**/webview/**     runs in the webview V8 realm (a separate
esbuild bundle, a browser context), NOT the
Extension-Host Node process c8 profiles —
structurally unreachable by this harness,
not a coverage gap (the fsm-lsp-branch
infra-exclusion discipline analogue).
- src/extension.ts      the activation entry runs in the bundled
dist/extension.js (the `main` field), a
different module instance than the
out/**-imported SUT the suite tests; its
activation IS exercised (the host activates
the extension) but attributed to the bundle,
not out/extension.js — excluded from the
per-file src ratchet to avoid a false 0%.
//floors: raise ONLY after BEHAVIOURAL §5.4 tests genuinely lift the measured
number; NEVER lower. Climbed-to TARGET 85/75 (recorded, NOT a Day-1
bar — the post-W4 ratchet, per Doc 32 §W4 + the brief). HONEST: the
so ~44% line — a low honest floor that ratchets UP beats a gamed
high one. NO assertion-free coverage-gaming test was added.
